newsitem.title: CHINA: Mitsubishi wins $180 mln China generator bid-paper.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi wins $180 mln China generator bid-paper.

text.p: Japan's Mitsubishi Corp and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries have won a bid to supply China with $180 million worth of power generating equipment, the China Daily said on Friday.

The Japanese firms signed a contract on Thursday to supply boiler, turbine generator and related equipment for the first phase construction of two 350-megawatt generating units of Sanhe power plant in the northern province of Hebei, the newspaper said.
"The Japanese won because of its advantages in technology," the newspaper said. Other bidders included U.S. and European companies, which were not identified.
The equipment would be bought with Japanese government loans, it said, adding that the plant was expected to greatly ease the power shortage in Beijing and northern China.
The Chinese buyers were China National Technology Import and Export Corp and Sanhe Power Generation Co Ltd, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
